# Toggle Group

Coordinate one or several pressed actions within a roving focus group.

## Usage

### Single

Keep one active value while moving and selecting with keyboard or pointer input.

<ComponentExample component="toggle-group" scenario="single" title="Single" description="Keep one active value while moving and selecting with keyboard or pointer input." :index="0" />

### Multiple

Select several values independently without collapsing the existing selection.

<ComponentExample component="toggle-group" scenario="multiple" title="Multiple" description="Select several values independently without collapsing the existing selection." :index="1" />

### Controlled

Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component.

<ComponentExample component="toggle-group" scenario="controlled" title="Controlled" description="Let the parent own the current value and apply accepted changes back to the component." :index="2" />

## Selection-state motion example

Selection is exposed through public ARIA or state attributes. A short color/scale transition confirms the result while remaining independent from keyboard navigation.

```css
[data-scope='toggle-group'][data-part='item'] {
  transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease;
}

[data-scope='toggle-group'][data-part='item'][aria-pressed='true'] {
  transform: scale(1.025);
  background: color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 12%, transparent);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-scope='toggle-group'][data-part='item'] {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

## API reference

See [Toggle Group API](/api/components/toggle-group) for props, events, slots, public types, part selectors, and keyboard behavior.

## Accessibility

The labeled group exposes each item as a pressed button and uses one roving tab stop.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) for the host accessibility contract.
